errors.text_span: the 2-Tier SimCSE model achieves the highest performance in all three metrics
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. For Sentiment Accuracy, the 2-Tier SimCSE model has one of the lowest scores (approx. 0.49). For Paraphrase Accuracy, the Single-task_baseline model has the highest score (approx. 0.79), which is higher than the 2-Tier SimCSE score (approx. 0.78).

errors.text_span: The Single-task_baseline model shows the lowest performance across all metrics
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The Single-task_baseline model has the highest performance for Paraphrase Accuracy (approx. 0.79) and one of the highest for Sentiment Accuracy (approx. 0.53). It only has the lowest performance for STS Correlation.

errors.text_span: with the performance generally increasing from the baseline to the 2-Tier SimCSE model
errors.evidence: This generalization is not accurate for all metrics. While STS Correlation shows a general increasing trend, Sentiment Accuracy shows a slight decreasing trend, and Paraphrase Accuracy fluctuates without a clear increasing trend.
